name: Ahzai
overview: Ahzai was a male member of the tribe of Levi, identified specifically as the son of Meshillemoth. His mention in Scripture is brief and primarily genealogical, emphasizing his Levitical heritage. There are no additional notes or details about his life or role beyond this lineage.
namesAndTitles: The name Ahzai means 'y-h-v-h has grasped,' reflecting a theophoric element that acknowledges God's involvement or action. This proper name, recorded in Nehemiah 11:13, does not appear to have been given directly by God but carries significant spiritual meaning.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture explicitly records Ahzai as a descendant of Meshillemoth and infers Azarel as his father. Beyond these connections, no other family relationships are documented in the biblical text.
scriptureSignificance: Ahzai's significance lies in his place within the Levitical genealogy, underscoring the continuity of the priestly tribe during the post-exilic period. His mention in Nehemiah 11:13 situates him among those who resettled Jerusalem, highlighting the restoration of Israel's religious leadership. Though not prominent in narrative events, his lineage affirms God's faithfulness in preserving the tribe of Levi.
